title: Chen et al. 2025, Indium-less and indium-free inverted perovskite solar cells using sputtered tin oxide transparent electrodes (Solar Energy 287:113235)
notes: Four characterised electrodes (Table 1): 140 nm ATO (optimised: RF 110 W, O2/Ar 6 %, 1.0 Pa, 500 °C), 280 nm ATO, 165 nm ITO (RF 60 W, pure Ar, 0.4 Pa), and a 140 nm ATO / 25 nm ITO bilayer.
Two targets: ATO Sb2O5:SnO2 = 5:95 wt% and ITO In2O3:SnO2 = 90:10 wt%. The ATO sweep ranges (O2/Ar 1-12.5 %, 0.6-1.2 Pa, RT-600 °C, 5-60 min) are ranges, not per-sample values.
Sweep points named in text (RT / 400 / 600 °C; 70 / 400 nm) and the 30 / 50 nm device electrodes (Table S1) have no conditions beyond one number: ambiguous samples.
Table 2 (stability) 'before' sheet resistances (ITO 34.1/33.2, ATO/ITO 210.3/223.2, ATO 1122.2/1200.1) disagree with Table 1 and are ambiguous; 'after' values are post-stress states and not recorded.
The abstract pairs 140 nm Hall data with 82.64 % transmittance, which the text later gives for the 280 nm film.
